parent_failed_campaign.outcome: Observer replay mismatch before 1ms, 2/2 smoke loads spent, no four-arm run; stopped without changing its budget. This campaign changes the measurement interface, not biology.

objective: Capture the actual coefficients returned to the protected CNS integrator on its last accepted stage each millisecond; reconstruct focal signed inputs using that stage state, then compare A peripheral/ALLN, B posterior convergence, C basal/reader/body in matched four-arm runs if gates pass.
unchanged_biology: No synapse edits, gains, onset history, or policy tuning. Parent sources and checkpoint fixed; observer is read-only.

rivals.A: ORN/ALLN and filtered PN release destroy or reverse peripheral lateral contrast before outgoing PN delivery.
rivals.B: Posterior convergence changes/cancels preserved PN contrast before DNa02 effective input.
rivals.C: Prepared basal state, descending readout, or body mapping dominates a correctly signed DNa02 response.

precommitted_readout.onset: trial 0 after field installation; verify first actually consumed nonzero sensory sample separately
precommitted_readout.primary: absolute yaw displacement at 400ms in all four arms and paired left/right, sham, uniform contrasts; opposite absolute turning signs needed for directional success
precommitted_readout.flow_samples: last committed CNS coefficient call for every complete trial millisecond, with exact stage state and actual target/rate; omit predictor/rejected attempts
precommitted_readout.flow_units: signed inherited rate-model input, never pA unless a true conductance V/E port is captured

instrument_gate: One-ms sham on/off from same settled checkpoint; exact neural/body and event-owner comparison, no sample/equation perturbation. Direct captured targets must match reconstructed stage equation for invertible focal receivers at <=1e-9 absolute and rates <=1e-12. If zero/saturated target, report censored rather than infer raw consumed signed sum. If no access to actual final accepted stage, stop.
scientific_gate: No A/B/C mechanism claim until four matched arms and unchanged 1e-4 numerical tolerance checked to interpreted horizon; current project full-state numerical reference may exceed this campaign budget, in which case leave mechanistic conclusion pending.
stop: Stop on first failed instrument gate, numeric gate, per-run/aggregate budget, or completed bounded readout. No post-hoc gain or threshold tuning; retain all failed evidence.
